comment: Task E Phase 2 experiment definition. split=whole-session: all tuning sees ONLY training sessions; validation sessions are held out until the final report. Rates are measured (physical timestamp derived), not nominal. 45 Hz era = t001..t005 firmware; 90 Hz = t006 OSR2048 firmware (nominal 100 Hz tick, measured 90 Hz P-stream).

audio_policy.comment: research-PDF starting thresholds; used for latch counting and release proxy semantics

event_reference.method: metrics.reference_v (1-s Gaussian-smoothed barometric derivative); cores at 0.5/0.3, entry extended to noise floor 0.05
event_reference.comment: derived reference intervals - descriptive proxy, NOT ground truth. Cores at 0.5 are unambiguous under hand-held approach motion; extending to the 0.05 noise floor (below statics p99=0.063) gives early, uncensored event entries without letting noise open events.

rate_pairs.comment: physically equivalent rate comparison (seconds-based parameterizations). drop pair crosses splits: t005_drop is validation, t006_drop training - reported as a rate comparison only, not a tuning input.
